test_title: PYST 8: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"The study of the origin and history of words."
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Etymology .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **Etymology** refers to the study of the origin of words and how their meanings and structures have evolved over time.
 
• It specifically examines the history of words, tracing their roots back to their earliest forms and languages.
 
• In contrast:
 
 
• **Philology** is the study of language in historical texts and its development over time.
 
• **Lexicography** deals with the compilation and writing of dictionaries.
 
• **Semantics** focuses on the meanings of words and their interpretation in context.
 
 

Correct sentence: *The study of the origin and history of words is called **Etymology**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Philology:**
 
 
• Derived from Greek, meaning "love of words."
 
• Broader than etymology, as it covers the study of language, literature, and historical texts.
 
 
 
• **Lexicography:**
 
 
• Focuses on dictionary-making and the cataloging of words, their meanings, and usage.
 
 
 
• **Semantics:**
 
 
• Deals with the meanings and interpretations of words, phrases, and sentences in context.
